findings.detail: Two Heartland fixed-rate rows misplace the disclosed 7.00% PIK component into basis_spread; basis_spread should be empty because no reference rate is shown.
The other five fires are explicitly S-plus floating-rate rows, so X04's fixed-rate classification or scope is overinclusive for those rows.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full source rows shows a mixed seven-row flag. Heartland rows 28 and 30 have no reference-rate token and disclose a fixed 14.50% coupon including 7.00% PIK, proving that stored basis_spread 7.0 is a PIK-to-spread column-remap error. In contrast, source rows such as Applitools table 13 row 15 expressly show S + 6.25% PIK and therefore are floating-rate positions whose spreads are valid; those residual fires reflect overinclusive fixed-rate classification. Because at least two flagged rows contain grounded data defects, the aggregate item is a real_error.
